To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the 3 form design coupled with ML estimation or multiple imputations provides a viable alternative for data collection when data are missing at random.
the 3-form method of data collection coupled with the maximum likelihood estimation procedure is an effective way of maximizing the utility of data obtained from a sample with missing values.
maximum likelihood estimation is the most efficient and accurate method for estimating variances and covariaries when data are MCAR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
maximizing the utility of data obtained with the 3-form survey design.
the development and application of a new method for estimating the reliability of self-report survey data.
how best to utilize the data obtained in planned missing value surveys.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
maximum likelihood methods, particularly the EM algorithm, should be considered as a viable alternative when planned missing value designs are used.
maximum likelihood methods, especially EM, should be the methods of choice when missing data occur.

the 3-form method of data collection, with its attendant missing data, can produce unbiased estimates of the variance-covariance matrix, but only when the data are MCAR and when the missing data are estimated using maximum likelihood procedures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ML estimation and multiple imputations provide the most accurate and efficient parameter estimates for data collected with planned missing data designs when data are missing at random.
the 3-form survey design is useful and efficient for collecting and analyzing data.
the 3-form survey design is an efficient way to obtain data with a minimum of missing values.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ML methods are the preferred methods to use when analyzing data with planned missing values.
maximum likelihood methods should be used to maximize the efficiency with which data are used, even if the data are not missing at random.
the ML estimation procedures can be used in conjunction with a planned missing design.
